09.12.02

The Linux4.BE gang has been hard at work. Jal0 has been hacking the BE hardware, mapping out the physical layout of the main board, creating schematics, and working on a monitor program (in CVS). Filip has made several discoveries while scanning various memory locations. Thanks to Filip's discoveries and help from themaw (Marc), I was able to write a simple scanning button driven keyboard driver (in CVS). Now you can activate the terminal and type to your heart's content. As always, there is still lots to be done and help is always welcome, even if you are not an experienced hacker.
